001179 – Zero Shot Hack

Think. Prompt. Code. Conquer.

Can You Solve Unfamiliar Coding Challenges Using Logic, Creativity, And The Power Of AI—Without Relying On Task-Specific Examples?

Welcome to Zero Shot Hack, a coding challenge designed to test participants' problem-solving abilities, logical reasoning, and adaptability in an AI-assisted programming environment. In a world where artificial intelligence is transforming software development, the ability to understand unfamiliar problems, formulate effective prompts, validate AI-generated solutions, and refine code efficiently is becoming an essential skill.

Zero Shot Hack challenges participants to approach unfamiliar coding problems with a combination of computational thinking, zero-shot prompting, AI-assisted programming, and independent reasoning. Participants must interpret problem statements, develop effective solution strategies, generate code with the assistance of AI tools where appropriate, and transform their ideas into functional, reliable solutions.

The challenge goes beyond simply generating code. Participants are expected to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs, identify logical errors, debug unexpected behaviour, validate results against the problem requirements, and optimize their implementations for correctness and efficiency.

Whether you are a college student passionate about coding or a professional looking to test your technical skills, Zero Shot Hack offers an opportunity to demonstrate how effectively you can combine human intelligence with AI-powered development to solve problems under pressure.

What Makes Zero Shot Hack Different?

  • Zero-Shot Problem Solving: Tackle unfamiliar coding challenges without relying on task-specific worked examples.
  • AI-Assisted Programming: Explore how effective prompting and AI-generated code can accelerate the development process.
  • Logical Reasoning: Break down complex problem statements, identify constraints, and formulate clear solution strategies.
  • Debugging and Validation: Detect errors, verify outputs, and ensure that solutions satisfy the given requirements.
  • Rapid Prototyping: Turn ideas into functional implementations efficiently while maintaining correctness and code quality.
  • Critical Evaluation: Demonstrate the ability to assess AI-generated solutions rather than blindly accepting their outputs.

Challenge Focus Areas:

1. Zero-Shot Prompting And AI-Assisted Coding:

Use clear, effective prompts to guide AI tools in generating solutions to unfamiliar programming problems. Demonstrate how prompt quality influences the relevance and correctness of generated code.

2. Logical And Computational Thinking:

Interpret problem statements, identify constraints, break problems into manageable components, and develop logical approaches to arrive at effective solutions.

3. Code Generation And Implementation:

Translate solution strategies into working code, leveraging AI assistance where appropriate while maintaining a clear understanding of the implementation.

4. Debugging And Output Validation:

Identify logical errors, resolve unexpected behaviour, test generated solutions, and verify that outputs meet the specified requirements.

5. Efficiency And Solution Optimization:

Evaluate the correctness, performance, and efficiency of solutions, making improvements wherever necessary.

How The Challenge Works:

Step 1: Understand The Problem

Participants receive coding challenges that require them to interpret unfamiliar problem statements, identify key requirements, and determine suitable solution approaches.

Step 2: Prompt And Develop

Participants apply logical reasoning and zero-shot prompting techniques to generate or develop solutions, using AI-assisted programming tools as permitted by the event rules.

Step 3: Test, Debug And Validate

Solutions are tested against the given requirements. Participants must identify errors, refine their code, and validate the correctness of their outputs.

Step 4: Demonstrate Your Solution

Participants demonstrate their implementations and showcase their ability to solve problems effectively through sound reasoning, reliable code, and appropriate use of AI assistance.

Evaluation Criteria:

Participants will be evaluated on their ability to:

  • Interpret problem statements accurately and identify essential requirements.
  • Apply effective zero-shot prompting and AI-assisted programming techniques.
  • Demonstrate logical reasoning and problem-solving skills.
  • Generate functional solutions that meet the specified requirements.
  • Debug code and validate outputs systematically.
  • Develop efficient, reliable, and innovative implementations.

Who Can Participate?

Zero Shot Hack welcomes:

  • College students interested in programming, artificial intelligence, and computational problem-solving.
  • Working professionals seeking to demonstrate their coding and AI-assisted development skills.
  • Participants who enjoy solving unfamiliar problems and experimenting with emerging AI-powered programming techniques.

Team Size: 4 members

Event Details:

  • Event Name: 001179 – Zero Shot Hack
  • Organizing School: SCOPE, VIT
  • Registration Fee: ₹350
  • Eligible Participants: College Students and Professionals
  • Team Size: 4 members
  • Official Website: https://events.vit.ac.in/

Please refer to the official event brochure for the schedule, participation guidelines, permitted tools, and other event-specific instructions.

Are You Ready To Put Your Problem-Solving Skills To The Test?

In AI-assisted programming, writing code is only one part of the challenge. Understanding the problem, asking the right questions, evaluating generated solutions, and ensuring that the final implementation works correctly are what truly set effective problem-solvers apart.

Think Beyond Examples. Prompt With Purpose. Debug With Precision. Solve With Intelligence.

Register for Zero Shot Hack and demonstrate your ability to tackle the unfamiliar with logic, creativity, and AI.
